question: Vijayanagara was founded on the banks of which river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tungabhadra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**** Tungabhadra**

__
 
• The ancient name of the river Tungabhadra was *Pampa.*
 
• In the epic *Ramayana*, the Tungabhadra River was known by the name of Pampa.
 
• Tungabhadra-__
 
 
• The Tungabhadra River rises from Karnataka state and flows through Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana states.
 
• The Tungabhadra River is formed by the confluence of the Tunga River and the Bhadra River at Koodli, Karnataka.
